axe-core 4.10.2 (vendored for tests only)

axe.min.js is the unmodified build from the npm package "axe-core" version 4.10.2
(https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core), copyright (c) Deque Systems, Inc.
It is licensed under the Mozilla Public License, version 2.0 (MPL-2.0); the licence
text is in LICENSE next to this file. LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.txt lists the notices of the
libraries bundled inside it.

It is used only by TestShots (internal/web/shots_test.go), which injects it into a
page in headless Chromium to check WCAG 2.2 AA rules. It is not served by the app,
not embedded in the binary, and not a Go dependency.

How it was fetched (inside the Playwright container, no change to go.mod):

    npm pack axe-core@4.10.2 && tar xzf axe-core-4.10.2.tgz
    sha256sum package/axe.min.js
    b511cd9dec01c76f4b2ad1723b66b6db37d4c2eb4ed199076e1829d9ee7b75e3

TestShots refuses to run when axe.min.js does not hash to the value above, so the file
cannot drift unnoticed. To upgrade, fetch the new version the same way, replace the three
files, and change the version and hash here and in shots_test.go.
